story: In October, Mia and Sam visit their aunt. They sit in her room and watch a movie. They make a plan for their life tomorrow.
title: A Visit in October
setting: A cozy living room in a house during autumn.

characters.name: Mia
characters.look: A young girl with short brown hair and a red sweater.

characters.name: Sam
characters.look: A young boy with blond hair and a blue shirt.

characters.name: Aunt
characters.look: A kind woman with long black hair and glasses.

sentences.en: It is a fine day in October.
sentences.zh: 这是十月里一个晴朗的日子。
sentences.scene_prompt: Mia and Sam stand outside near a tree with orange leaves under a bright sun.

sentences.en: Mia and Sam visit their kind aunt.
sentences.zh: Mia和Sam去拜访他们亲切的姨妈。
sentences.scene_prompt: Mia and Sam walk toward a kind woman with long black hair and glasses standing at a door.

sentences.en: They sit in her small room.
sentences.zh: 他们坐在她的小房间里。
sentences.scene_prompt: Mia and Sam sit on a soft rug in a small room with colorful pillows.

sentences.en: Sometimes they watch a funny movie.
sentences.zh: 有时他们会看一部有趣的电影。
sentences.scene_prompt: Mia and Sam sit on a sofa and watch a large television screen.

sentences.en: They finish their snacks at four o'clock.
sentences.zh: 他们在四点钟吃完了零食。
sentences.scene_prompt: Mia and Sam sit at a table with empty bowls next to a clock showing 4:00.

sentences.en: Aunt will let them play games.
sentences.scene_prompt: A kind woman with long black hair and glasses smiles at Mia and Sam.

sentences.en: Mia shows her pretty birthday card.
sentences.zh: Mia展示她漂亮的生日卡片。
sentences.scene_prompt: Mia holds up a small colorful rectangle card for Sam to see.

sentences.en: They plan our fun life for tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 他们计划我们明天的快乐生活。
sentences.scene_prompt: Mia and Sam look at a large paper map on a table together.

sentences.en: They start to rest on the sofa.
sentences.zh: 他们开始在沙发上休息。
sentences.scene_prompt: Mia and Sam lie down on a large sofa with blankets.
